titleFront: The Galaxy May Need A Legend

flipToBack.timing: OPTIONAL trigger (OptionalGameTextTriggerAction, player may decline) fired when a battle is just initiated - battle-event timing, not standing state
flipToBack.prose: MAY flip when a battle was just initiated involving a Resistance character, while Luke is on Ahch-To. Flipping immediately places Luke out of play and prevents all weapon firing for remainder of that battle (coded on the back's cardFlipped trigger).

children.req: battle participant: a Resistance character is in the just-initiated battle

flipToFront.timing: NEVER. Back has no flip trigger and no lose/out-of-play condition. Instead, on the flip itself (cardFlipped) a REQUIRED trigger fires.
flipToFront.prose: On cardFlipped: required action places Luke out of play (PlaceCardOutOfPlayFromTableEffect on Filters.findFirstActive(game, self, Filters.Luke); comment notes immunity to Bring Him Before Me restrictions) and adds MayNotBeFiredModifier(Filters.any) until end of battle - no weapons may be fired for remainder of that battle.

requirementSemantics: Flip is OPTIONAL and event-timed: only available in the trigger window right after a battle initiation with a Resistance character participating; Rando must actively choose it - no automatic table-state flip exists.
Luke leg is presence-on-planet semantics: Filters.on(Title.Ahch_To) (anywhere on the Ahch-To planet), not control/occupy of a specific site.
Flip COST (in effect): Luke is placed out of play by the back's required cardFlipped trigger - flipping trades Luke permanently for the back-side engine.

The once-per-game Force Pile upload is shared across both sides via GameTextActionId.THE_GALAXY_MAY_NEED_A_LEGEND_FORCE_PILE_UPLOAD; on the back it is additionally gated by self.getWhileInPlayData() == null, and both sides stamp WhileInPlayData(true) after use.
typedIdentities: Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.location, Icon.EPISODE_I), Filters.and(Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_VII), Filters.character, Filters.abilityMoreThan(4))) (may not deploy)
Filters.Luke may deploy only to Filters.AhchTo_location (MayNotDeployToLocationModifier with Filters.not(Filters.AhchTo_location))
Filters.and(Filters.unique, Filters.Resistance_character, Filters.your(self)) (back drain +1 pairs; destiny-cancel needs 2 participating)
Filters.opponents(self) immunity to attrition limited to < 6 (back)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Ahch-To: Saddle and any [Episode VII] battleground (Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Icon.EPISODE_VII)) from Reserve Deck (front:55-72).

Front pull: once per turn (deploy phase check isOnceDuringYourPhase DEPLOY), deploy an Ahch-To location or [Episode VII] battleground from Reserve Deck: Filters.or(Filters.AhchTo_location, Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Icon.EPISODE_VII)) (front:119-133).
Shared once-per-game: take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle (front:96-117; also available on back if WhileInPlayData not set, BACK:81-103).
Back: once during your turn, peek at top card of Force Pile and Reserve Deck, return both (any order) to top of one of those piles (BACK:105-122).
otherObligations: Front, remainder of game: Luke deploys only to Ahch-To; you may not Force drain on Ahch-To; may not deploy [Episode I] locations or non-[Episode VII] characters of ability > 4 (front:74-87).
Back, on flip: Luke placed out of play; weapons may not be fired for remainder of battle (BACK:51-73).
Back: opponent's immunity to attrition limited to < 6 (BACK:132).
Back: your Force drains +1 where you have two of your unique Resistance characters together (ForceDrainModifier via Filters.sameLocationAs pairs, BACK:133).
Back: once per turn during battle with 2+ of your unique Resistance characters participating, may cancel an opponent's just-drawn destiny to cause a redraw (BACK:138-160).

Strategic note from law: the flip is a one-way trade of Luke for the Resistance engine; Rando should only flip when Luke has finished his front-side job (drain denial is on Ahch-To anyway) and 2+ unique Resistance characters can be paired for drains/destiny control.

profileGaps: keyCharacterFilter is null; the flip requires Luke on Ahch-To AND a Resistance character participating in a just-initiated battle - neither actor is encoded.
No representation that the flip is OPTIONAL and battle-initiation-timed (no table-state flip exists); profile fields assume standing-state gates.
No representation of the flip consequence: Luke is placed out of play immediately on flip (Rando must value-check Luke before choosing to flip).

flipGateSite null; the gate 'location' is the whole Ahch-To planet (Filters.on(Title.Ahch_To)), plus any battleground for the battle leg - not expressible via current fields but objectiveNamedLocations only lists Saddle/Ahch-To location/Ep7 battleground without flip tagging.
